pr.title: Add source_branch param to submit_task for artifact reuse
pr.description:
Adds a `source_branch` parameter to `submit_task` so the orchestrator can load
large artifacts (plan, analysis) from a prior run's git branch server-side,
avoiding the need to pass 50-80KB content through MCP tool parameters.
Also relaxes the branch-exists check to allow reusing branches when no active
pipeline state exists.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: New unit tests for source_branch parameter threading, artifact reading, prefix fallback, and branch-exists relaxation
- Manual: Submit a task with source_branch pointing to a prior run's branch, verify plan and analysis are loaded and contract is populated
